name: Bitflow
description: The main DEX on Stacks (Bitcoin L2). Agents can swap and LP through HODLMM (bin-based concentrated liquidity, DLMM), XYK constant-product pools and StableSwap pools, or get the best route across Bitflow and other Stacks DEXs from Bitflow's public Quote API, which returns ready-made contract-call parameters.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-x-for-y-simple-multi(pool-trait <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, min-dy uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Swap x-amount of the pool's X token for Y in one DLMM pool, walking up to 319 bins. Token traits must be the pool's x-token/y-token (read pool get-pool). Reverts err u2003 if output < min-dy, err u2012 if stacks-block-time (unix seconds) > deadline. Returns (ok {in, out}). Add post-conditions (Deny mode) for the tokens sent.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-y-for-x-simple-multi(pool-trait <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-amount uint, min-dx uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Reverse direction: Y in, X out, same rules.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-x-for-y-simple-range-multi(pool-trait <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, min-dy uint, max-steps uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Same as swap-x-for-y-simple-multi but caps the number of bins traversed at max-steps (1-319) to bound execution cost.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-y-for-x-simple-range-multi(pool-trait <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-amount uint, min-dx uint, max-steps uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Y-for-X with a max-steps cap.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-simple-multi(swaps (list 5 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, amount: uint, min-received: uint, x-for-y: bool, max-steps: uint}), deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Up to 5 single-pool swaps in one call (the form the Quote API returns as function_name swap-simple-multi; total max-steps should stay <= ~290 per docs). Each entry has its own min-received. Returns (ok {results: list of {in, out}}).

keyFunctions.signature: swap-multi(swaps (list 319 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, expected-bin-id: int, amount: uint, min-received: uint, x-for-y: bool}), max-unfavorable-bins uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Strict per-bin swap: each entry swaps in a specific expected-bin-id (signed, -500..500); fails with err u2002 if more than max-unfavorable-bins bins moved against you. Use the Quote API's 'full' parameters to build it.

keyFunctions.signature: add-relative-liquidity-same-multi(positions (list 288 {active-bin-id-offset: int, x-amount: uint, y-amount: uint, min-dlp: uint, max-x-liquidity-fee: uint, max-y-liquidity-fee: uint}), pool-trait <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, active-bin-tolerance (optional {expected-bin-id: int, max-deviation: uint}), deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: 'Simple mode' add: deposit into bins at offsets from the active bin at execution time. Only Y may go below the active bin, only X above it. min-dlp = minimum bin shares per position; max-*-liquidity-fee cap the fee charged for adding to the active bin. Optional tolerance reverts if the active bin moved more than max-deviation from expected-bin-id. Returns (ok {results, active-bin-id, active-bin-id-delta}). Broadcast in Allow mode per docs.

keyFunctions.signature: add-liquidity-multi(positions (list 333 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, bin-id: int, x-amount: uint, y-amount: uint, min-dlp: uint, max-x-liquidity-fee: uint, max-y-liquidity-fee: uint}), deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: 'Strict mode' add to exact bins. bin-id is SIGNED (-500..500) here; the API's prepare helpers output unsigned ids (0..1000) and the official executing code converts back (signed = unsigned - 500). Reverts if state changed. Returns (ok list of shares minted).

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-liquidity-same-multi(positions (list 326 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, bin-id: int, amount: uint, min-x-amount: uint, min-y-amount: uint}), x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, min-x-amount-total uint, min-y-amount-total uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Burn `amount` bin shares from each signed bin-id of one pool; totals are checked against min-x/y-amount-total. Size from the API's current-bins endpoint (userShares). Returns (ok {results, x-amount, y-amount}).

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-relative-liquidity-same-multi(positions (list 300 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, active-bin-id-offset: int, amount: uint, min-x-amount: uint, min-y-amount: uint}), x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, min-x-amount-total uint, min-y-amount-total uint, deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Simple-mode withdraw by offset from the active bin.

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-liquidity-multi(positions (list 326 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, bin-id: int, amount: uint, min-x-amount: uint, min-y-amount: uint}), deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Withdraw across several pools/bins (per-position minimums).

keyFunctions.signature: move-liquidity-multi(positions (list 220 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, from-bin-id: int, to-bin-id: int, amount: uint, min-dlp: uint, max-x-liquidity-fee: uint, max-y-liquidity-fee: uint}), deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Move `amount` shares from one bin to another (rebalancing a range) without leaving the pool.

keyFunctions.signature: move-relative-liquidity-multi(positions (list 208 {pool-trait: <dlmm-pool-trait>, x-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait: <sip-010-trait>, from-bin-id: int, active-bin-id-offset: int, amount: uint, min-dlp: uint, max-x-liquidity-fee: uint, max-y-liquidity-fee: uint}), deadline-time (optional uint))
keyFunctions.description: Move shares to a bin at an offset from the active bin.

keyFunctions.signature: get-pool()
keyFunctions.description: Full pool state: x-token (sBTC), y-token (USDCx), bin-step, active-bin-id (signed), protocol/provider/variable fees per side, core-address, pool status data. Other HODLMM pools (list via GET /quotes/v2/pools) expose the same interface.

keyFunctions.signature: get-active-bin-id()
keyFunctions.description: Active bin, signed int (-500..500).

keyFunctions.signature: get-bin-balances(id uint)
keyFunctions.description: {x-balance, y-balance, bin-shares} for a bin. NOTE: this map is keyed by UNSIGNED id (signed + 500).

keyFunctions.signature: get-user-bins(user principal)
keyFunctions.description: List of (unsigned) bin ids where the user holds shares.

keyFunctions.signature: get-balance(token-id uint, user principal)
keyFunctions.description: SIP-013 share balance of a user in one bin (token-id = unsigned bin id).

keyFunctions.signature: get-overall-balance(user principal)
keyFunctions.description: User's total shares across all bins.

keyFunctions.signature: get-dy(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Quote Y out for x-amount of X (fees included). Declared public (takes traits) but makes no writes, so call it read-only via the Hiro call-read endpoint. Returns err u1010 if the pool is disabled.

keyFunctions.signature: get-dx(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Quote X out for y-amount of Y.

keyFunctions.signature: get-dlp(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: LP preview for adding x-amount: {dlp, y-amount required}.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-x-for-y(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, min-dy uint)
keyFunctions.description: Swap X for Y in an XYK v1.2 pool (pool contracts named xyk-pool-*-v-1-2 etc. under SM1793C4R5PZ4NS4VQ4WMP7SKKYVH8JZEWSZ9HCCR; get the list from get-pool-by-id or the Quote API). Token traits must equal the pool's x-token/y-token; STX pools use token-stx-v-1-2 as the STX trait. min-dy must be > 0 and output >= min-dy (err u1020). Returns (ok dy).

keyFunctions.signature: swap-y-for-x(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-amount uint, min-dx uint)
keyFunctions.description: Swap Y for X; min-dx > 0.

keyFunctions.signature: add-liquidity(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, min-dlp uint)
keyFunctions.description: Add liquidity proportional to reserves: you supply x-amount and the contract pulls y-amount = x-amount * y-balance / x-balance. min-dlp (> 0) is the minimum LP tokens (the pool contract is the LP token). Returns (ok dlp).

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-liquidity(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, amount uint, min-x-amount uint, min-y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Burn `amount` LP tokens for both tokens. Returns (ok {x-amount, y-amount}).

keyFunctions.signature: get-pool-by-id(id uint)
keyFunctions.description: {id, name, symbol, pool-contract} for pool id 1..get-last-pool-id() (45 at research time).

keyFunctions.signature: get-last-pool-id()
keyFunctions.description: Number of XYK v1.2 pools created.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-helper-a(amount uint, min-received uint, xyk-tokens {a: <xyk-ft-trait>, b: <xyk-ft-trait>}, xyk-pools {a: <xyk-pool-trait>})
keyFunctions.description: Swap token a -> b through one XYK v1.2 pool, detecting the direction itself. Reverts if result < min-received. Returns (ok received).

keyFunctions.signature: swap-helper-b(amount uint, min-received uint, xyk-tokens {a: <xyk-ft-trait>, b: <xyk-ft-trait>, c: <xyk-ft-trait>, d: <xyk-ft-trait>}, xyk-pools {a: <xyk-pool-trait>, b: <xyk-pool-trait>})
keyFunctions.description: Two hops: a->b in pool a, then c->d in pool b (normally b = c). swap-helper-c/-d/-e extend to 3/4/5 hops.

keyFunctions.signature: get-quote-a(amount uint, xyk-tokens {a: <xyk-ft-trait>, b: <xyk-ft-trait>}, xyk-pools {a: <xyk-pool-trait>})
keyFunctions.description: Quote for swap-helper-a (public, no writes; call read-only). get-quote-b..e match the multi-hop helpers.

keyFunctions.signature: get-swap-status()
keyFunctions.description: false if admins disabled the helper.

contracts.name: STX SIP-010 wrapper for XYK v1.2 (token-stx-v-1-2)

keyFunctions.signature: transfer(amount uint, sender principal, recipient principal, memo (optional (buff 34)))
keyFunctions.description: Moves native STX (micro-STX, 6 decimals) behind a SIP-010 interface. Pass this contract as the STX token trait in XYK/stableswap v1.2 pools; you do not need to call it directly. Add an STX post-condition.

keyFunctions.signature: get-balance(address principal)
keyFunctions.description: Native STX balance of an address (micro-STX).

keyFunctions.signature: get-dy(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Quote Y out for X in a stableswap v1.2 pool (public with no writes; call read-only).

keyFunctions.signature: get-dx(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Quote X out for Y.

keyFunctions.signature: get-dlp(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: LP tokens for an (imbalanced) deposit.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-x-for-y(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, min-dy uint)
keyFunctions.description: Swap X for Y; reverts if output < min-dy. Returns (ok dy).

keyFunctions.signature: swap-y-for-x(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-amount uint, min-dx uint)
keyFunctions.description: Swap Y for X.

keyFunctions.signature: add-liquidity(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, y-amount uint, min-dlp uint)
keyFunctions.description: Add any mix of X and Y (the pool applies its liquidity-fee to imbalanced adds). Returns (ok dlp).

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-liquidity(pool-trait <stableswap-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, amount uint, min-x-amount uint, min-y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Burn LP for both tokens proportionally.

keyFunctions.signature: get-pool-by-id(id uint)
keyFunctions.description: Pool registry (2 pools at research time; see get-last-pool-id).

keyFunctions.signature: get-dy(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <lp-trait>, x-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Quote stSTX out for x-amount micro-STX. Use y-token = SP4SZE494VC2YC5JYG7AYFQ44F5Q4PYV7DVMDPBG.ststx-token, lp-token = SPQC38PW542EQJ5M11CR25P7BS1CA6QT4TBXGB3M.stx-ststx-lp-token-v-1-2 (e.g. 1 STX -> 0.839722 stSTX at research time).

keyFunctions.signature: get-dx(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <lp-trait>, y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Quote STX out for y-amount micro-stSTX (sell direction carries extra fees).

keyFunctions.signature: swap-x-for-y(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <lp-trait>, x-amount uint, min-y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Swap native STX (x) for stSTX. Returns (ok dy); errors are string-ascii messages. Add an STX post-condition.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-y-for-x(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <lp-trait>, y-amount uint, min-x-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Swap stSTX for STX.

keyFunctions.signature: add-liquidity(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <lp-trait>, x-amount-added uint, y-amount-added uint, min-lp-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Add STX and/or stSTX; mints stx-ststx-lp-token-v-1-2.

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-liquidity(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <lp-trait>, lp-amount uint, min-x-amount uint, min-y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Burn LP for STX and stSTX.

keyFunctions.signature: get-pair-data(y-token <sip-010-trait>, lp-token <sip-010-trait>)
keyFunctions.description: Pair state: balances, amplification coefficient, total shares, approval, decimals.

keyFunctions.signature: swap-x-for-y(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, x-amount uint, min-dy uint)
keyFunctions.description: Legacy v1.1 XYK swap (pools like xyk-pool-stx-aeusdc-v-1-1). Prefer v1.2; v1.1 pools may be disabled (last core call was set-pool-status).

keyFunctions.signature: withdraw-liquidity(pool-trait <xyk-pool-trait>, x-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, y-token-trait <sip-010-trait>, amount uint, min-x-amount uint, min-y-amount uint)
keyFunctions.description: Remove liquidity from a legacy v1.1 pool.

keyFunctions.signature: get-pool-by-id(id uint)
keyFunctions.description: Legacy pool registry.

offchainApis.name: Bitflow Quote/App API v2 (HODLMM engine and aggregator)
offchainApis.use: GET /quotes/v2/pools, /quotes/v2/tokens, /quotes/v2/bins/{pool_id}; POST /quotes/v2/quote (best route incl. other Stacks DEXs) then /quotes/v2/swap or /quotes/v2/agg/swap for contract_address, function_name, args and Deny-mode post-conditions; GET /app/v2/users/{user}/positions/{pool_id}/current-bins to size LP withdrawals. Check /quotes/v2/status tip_lag == 0 first. 100 req/s per IP without a key.

offchainApis.name: Bitflow public ticker
offchainApis.use: 24h prices, volumes and USD liquidity per pair.

offchainApis.name: Bitflow SDK (@bitflowlabs/core-sdk)
offchainApis.use: TypeScript SDK for token lists, routes, quotes and swap execution; API keys optional (500 req/min per IP default).

actions.name: swap (best route)
actions.description: Swap any supported token pair at the best price across Bitflow and other Stacks venues.
actions.how: POST /quotes/v2/quote {input_token, output_token, amount_in (base units, string), slippage_tolerance}; take an executable route; POST /quotes/v2/swap (or /quotes/v2/agg/swap for agg_buildable routes); sign a Stacks contract-call with the returned contract, function, args and post-conditions (Deny mode).

actions.name: swap in one HODLMM pool
actions.how: Read pool get-pool for x-token/y-token; dlmm-swap-router-v-1-2.swap-x-for-y-simple-multi(pool, x-token, y-token, amount, min-out, (some deadline)) with post-conditions on the token sent.

actions.name: swap in an XYK pool
actions.how: xyk-core-v-1-2.get-dy(pool, x, y, amount) read-only; then swap-x-for-y(pool, x, y, amount, quote*(1-slippage)). Use token-stx-v-1-2 for STX.

actions.name: add HODLMM liquidity
actions.description: Provide liquidity in bins around the price.
actions.how: Get bins from /quotes/v2/bins/{pool}; build positions (Y below active bin, X above); dlmm-liquidity-router-v-1-2.add-relative-liquidity-same-multi(positions, pool, x, y, (some {expected-bin-id, max-deviation}), deadline).

actions.name: remove HODLMM liquidity
actions.how: GET /app/v2/users/{you}/positions/{pool}/current-bins (require clean, complete, tipLag 0); withdraw-liquidity-same-multi with signed bin ids (unsigned - 500) and per-bin share amounts.

risks: Admin powers: XYK/StableSwap core admins (up to 5 principals) can disable pools (set-pool-status), change protocol/provider fees and fee addresses; the swap helper has an on/off switch; HODLMM pools have variable-fee managers and are administered via the DLMM core. A disabled pool makes swaps revert (e.g. legacy xyk-pool-stx-aeusdc-v-1-1/v-1-2 returned err u1010 POOL_DISABLED at research time).
Contracts are versioned, not upgradeable: new versions (v-1-1 -> v-1-2) replace old ones, so integrations must follow current addresses; old pools may be disabled or drained of liquidity.

Audits listed in docs: Clarity Alliance (XYK June 2024, StableSwap Sept 2024, StableSwap staking Sept 2024, StableSwap Midpoint Mar/Apr 2025), CoinFabrik (Dec 2023), StrataLabs (June 2023). No HODLMM/DLMM audit is listed on the docs audits page. Immunefi bug bounty is live.

HODLMM quotes and position data come from an off-chain engine that can lag the chain (check tip_lag); strict-mode transactions revert if the active bin moves, simple-mode ones execute at the then-current bin.

Stacks transactions should use Deny-mode post-conditions; without them a malicious token trait could move more funds than expected. Only pass token/pool traits that match the pool's own x-token/y-token.
Many listed tokens are bridged (sBTC, aeUSDC, USDCx, pBTC etc.) and carry their bridge's risk.
notes: Stacks is a Clarity-VM chain, so vm is 'mixed', chainId is null and addresses are contract principals. Signatures are Clarity (name(arg type, ...)); trait arguments are passed as contract principals. Sources: the DLMM swap/liquidity routers are named in the official HODLMM API docs (v1 page), the sBTC/USDCx pool in the v2 docs, stableswap-stx-ststx-v-1-2 and xyk-core-v-1-1 on the docs 'Deployed Contracts > Stacks' page, and xyk-core-v-1-2, xyk-swap-helper-v-1-2, stableswap-core-v-1-2 and token-stx-v-1-2 in Bitflow's official npm SDK (@bitflowlabs/core-sdk 4.2.0, dist/src/keeper/types.js ALLOWED_CONTRACTS, and pool data) — the docs deployed-contracts page has not been updated for these v1.2 contracts, but they are the active ones (xyk-core-v-1-2 ~144k txs vs v1.1 ~10k). Every contract was confirmed via the Hiro API (interface/source) on 2026-11-25 and signatures were taken from the deployed Clarity source. Left out: dlmm-core-v-1-1 (the routers call SP1PFR4V08H1RAZXREBGFFQ59WB739XM8VVGTFSEA.dlmm-core-v-1-1, but that address is not listed on any official page I could find), Bitflow's agg-* aggregator routers (only agg-treasury-v-1-1 is named in docs; the Quote API returns the router to call), the other legacy StableSwap pairs/earn/LP-token contracts and the old cross-DEX routers/wrappers on the deployed-contracts page (still listed there; see that page), keeper contracts, and individual pool contracts beyond one HODLMM example (discover pools via GET /quotes/v2/pools or core get-pool-by-id).
